official_evidence.finding: PB 05.13 introduces L2A surface-reflectance edge improvements, revised no-data boundaries, cast-shadow classification, water atmospheric correction, saturation metadata consistency, JPEG2000 encoding optimization, and spectral-response metadata updates.
ESA scheduled PB 05.13 deployment for 21 September 2026 and states that generated products comply with PSD v15.2.

PSD v15.2 continues to specify metadata-driven BOA offset and quantification scaling and describes the L2A mask products. This specification is structural evidence only, not proof of a particular unacquired product's internal metadata or QA.

method_implications: The existing 05.12 reader cannot be reused unchanged for the 05.13 candidate; a distinct candidate-specific parser and header test path is required before any real pixel attempt.

SCL and no-data algorithm differences can change masked-area measurements between dates even with the same class-number exclusion list; report baseline as a quality-method limitation, not a landscape change.
Reflectance over water and spectral response metadata may differ; no reflectance difference, index change, or event attribution is admissible merely from a visually aligned pair.
Only unacquired-product metadata is available now; internal product tags, selected-mask structure, AOI clear pixels, and cross-date registration remain unknown.
